text:
mira: Quick debate for tomorrows sync: trying a new left-rail IA to reduce cognitive load. Proposal: three primary clusters — Projects, Models, Platform — plus an optional compact rail that shows only icons. Main asks: breadcrumb composition, permalink shape (should cluster slug be explicit?), and keyboard/a11y behaviour for collapsed clusters.
ben: Im for explicit cluster slug in permalinks (eg /ws/:ws/cluster:models/model-123). Deterministic routing reduces highlight ambiguity across workspaces. We need a compatibility resolver for legacy paths though.
ashley: Agree on resolver. Breadcrumbs: show cluster > section > item when rail is collapsed or icons-only. But visually we could use a subtle cluster chip (left of breadcrumb) to keep the line short. Make chip aria-hidden and include cluster as first breadcrumb item for assistive tech.
noor: Accessibility first: collapsed cluster headers must be native <button aria-expanded> with aria-controls. When focus lands in the rail, ensure the first actionable item receives focus, and provide a visible focus ring in both compact and expanded modes. Also add a skip link "Skip to main content" that is the first tabbable element.
mira: UX fallback behaviour: when a permalink points to an id that isnt in the current workspace, show a non-modal banner above content: "Linked item not found in this workspace  showing [Models] hub" with an action "Try original workspace". Do not auto-switch. Offer telemetry for fallbacks.
ben: Dev note: implement highlight precedence: exact leaf match > section match > cluster match. Add unit tests and an e2e that simulates missing-id fallback. Also add 301 redirects from old shallow paths to the new cluster-explicit format to avoid breaking existing links.
ashley: Copy bikeshed options: Cluster label Option A: "Projects" (product-friendly). Option B: "Apps & Jobs" (explicit to infra users). Ill run a quick console poll and report. Also draft banner copy variants.
accessibility-bot: [audit] prototype missing aria-controls on collapsed cluster headers and skip-link absent. See https://ci/redwood/a11y/942.
noor: Thanks bot. Action items: Ben -> resolver + highlight tests + 301s + telemetry. Noor -> ARIA audit and keyboard-only recordings. Ashley -> run copy poll and prepare chip vs breadcrumb mocks in Figma. Mira -> schedule 20-min sync tomorrow 10:00 PT to align on ship approach.
mira: Perfect. Agenda for sync: 1) compat plan 2) ARIA checklist findings 3) copy poll + mock review 4) rollout plan (chip default + A/B explicit crumb). :calendar: 
ben: Starting the unit tests now. Will also add integration test to CI to catch highlight flakiness.
ashley: Poll posted. Mock links in #design with annotations.
noor: Running audit and will attach keyboard videos to the PR.
mira: Great — see you tomorrow. :thumbsup:
